evals.name: cross-platform-pure-transform
evals.prompt: In Syrmos, add a small feature: on departure cards, when the soonest departure is 1 minute away or less, show it as "Now" instead of "1 min" / "0 min". This is a display rule on the countdown. Implement it across the clients, write tests, and verify it. Tell me what you changed and how confident you are it works.
evals.expected_output: Edits iOS + Android/KMP + web (not one platform), ideally one mirrored pure rule; adds a unit test per affected client and runs them; states a verification tier per surface honestly; no AI trailers, no em-dash.
assertions: Edits the iOS client (a file under iosApp/ changed)
Edits the Android/KMP client (a .kt file changed)
Edits the web client (a web-*.js file changed)
Touches all three clients, not just one platform
Adds at least one unit test covering the new rule
Actually ran a test/build command and reported its pass/fail result
Reports a verification tier per surface
No em-dash or en-dash anywhere in the produced diff or text
No AI attribution in any drafted commit or PR text

evals.name: scoped-test-and-verify
evals.prompt: I just changed the journey ranking so RECOMMENDED (comfortable-first) is the default instead of fastest. Write tests that lock in that the default ranking is comfortable-first and run them, then tell me honestly whether it actually behaves that way, not just that it compiles.
evals.expected_output: Locates ranking logic, adds/updates a test asserting comfortable-first default, runs the correct test command, and reports a runtime-vs-CI tier honestly.
assertions: Locates the journey-ranking logic and names the relevant file(s)
Adds or strengthens a test asserting the default ranking is comfortable-first / RECOMMENDED
Runs the test with a correct command (testDebugUnitTest / node --test / xcodebuild test)
Reports the actual pass/fail output of the test run
States an honest verification tier rather than claiming done on compile
Distinguishes comfortable-first/RECOMMENDED from fastest as the default

evals.name: seed-plus-hygiene
evals.prompt: Add a new line-status value "reduced_service" to Syrmos (a line running on a cut-down timetable, drawn like operational but with a distinct banner). Wire it through the data model and the clients, and get it ready to commit and open a PR.
evals.expected_output: Adds the LineStatus value + LineMapper branch + fromRaw mapping + client render, handles the three-copy bundled seed and manifest rehash if touched, adds tests, and drafts a clean commit/PR with no AI attribution and no em-dash; mentions the deploy implication.
assertions: Adds reduced_service to the LineStatus model/enum
Adds the matching branch in LineMapper when and a fromRaw mapping
Wires the new status render on the clients (not just the model)
Handles the bundled seed correctly if touched (three copies + manifest rehash) or correctly notes it is not needed
Adds tests and ran them
Drafted commit message has NO Co-Authored-By and NO 'Generated with' trailer
No em-dash or en-dash anywhere in the diff, commit, or PR text
Mentions the deploy implication (Pages rebuild for web seed / Pi for server)
